facts.fact: NITA-U's executive director Hatwib Mugasa said Uganda's National Backbone Infrastructure already runs to Mutukula on the Tanzania border and to the Busia and Malaba border points with Kenya, per the Monitor.

The Monitor reports that the Uganda Electricity Transmission Company's DWDM fibre along its power line, over 1,775.2 km, was leased to four telecom companies, with fibre cores paid three months ahead and co-location space twelve months ahead.
